content.text:
I fixed the bug in `solution/core.py`, and the visible suite now passes (2 passed). The cause was in `wrap_text`: it split the input into paragraphs correctly but joined the wrapped paragraphs back together with a single `"
"`, so the blank line between paragraphs disappeared. It now joins them with `"

"`, so paragraphs stay separated by exactly one blank line, and runs of several blank lines still collapse to one, as the tests expect. I made one extra change the tests don't cover: a line containing only spaces or tabs now counts as a paragraph break (`not line.strip()` instead of `line == ""`). Before, such a line was silently merged into the paragraph around it. Revert that line if you want only the strict fix.
